渡轮离岸后，Angel Island 把城市换成山坡、海风与另一种观看湾区的距离: As the ferry leaves the shore, Angel Island offers hills, sea air and a new distance from the city. For a first visit, focus on Ayala Cove and the immigration station, combining walking and bay views with history that deserves time. Many immigrants faced inspection and detention here; leave space to reflect on the poems and personal stories during your visit.

旧金山出发查 Golden Gate Ferry，Tiburon 出发查 Ang: For San Francisco, check Golden Gate Ferry; for Tiburon, check Angel Island Tiburon Ferry. Verify each operator’s schedule, ticketing and departure dock separately; do not assume the other operator is an automatic backup.
上岛需交通及入园预算；Golden Gate Ferry 当前说明船票含州立公园: Budget for transportation and park admission. Golden Gate Ferry currently includes state park admission in its fare and advises arranging return tickets before traveling. Some immigration station interiors charge separately; free exhibition spaces also have their own opening arrangements.
带够饮水、午餐、防晒和挡风外套；岛上餐饮、接驳和观光车具有季节性，只有确认实际营: Bring enough drinking water, lunch, sun protection and a windproof layer. Island food service, shuttles and trams are seasonal; include them only after confirming actual operation.

第一站 · Ayala Cove 登岛与辨认返程码头: Stop 1 · Arrive at Ayala Cove and identify the return landing
下船后先拍下返航信息，确认登船队列和洗手间位置，预留 20–30 分钟整理背包与: Photograph the return information, identify the boarding queue and restroom, and allow 20–30 minutes to organize bags and read the map. Before following a crowd uphill, confirm whether you are taking the shorter stair route or the longer road option.
The official stair route is about 1 mile one way from the landing with approximately 140 steps. The stair-free route is about 1.5 miles and still steep in places. Allow walking time for your group, then roughly 60–90 minutes for exhibits. Check opening and admission that day and distinguish the detention barracks from the immigration museum in the former hospital.
第三站 · 返回 Ayala Cove 草地与码头: Stop 3 · Return to the Ayala Cove lawn and ferry landing
按来时已确认的路线返回，先到码头附近，再决定是否野餐或看水面。建议把计划回船前: Return by the route you already checked. Reach the landing area before deciding whether to picnic or watch the water. As an editorial planning target, be back at Ayala Cove 30 minutes before your chosen boat. Golden Gate Ferry separately recommends reaching the dock about 15 minutes before departure; that is not the time to start walking from the museum.
把无障碍、家庭节奏和天气放进同一个计划: Plan mobility, family pace and weather together
免台阶并不等于平路。州立公园说明去移民站的道路有陡坡，只向电量充足的强动力电动轮: Stair-free does not mean level. State Parks notes steep hills on the longer road to the immigration station and recommends it only for power-wheelchair users with sufficient battery and capability. Manual-wheelchair users should contact the park in advance about workable assistance. Staff rides and commercial shuttles are not guaranteed on arrival and may not accommodate power wheelchairs or visitors unable to transfer to a vehicle seat. With small strollers or young children, the Ayala Cove lawn, visitor center area and a picnic can form a complete shorter visit.
风起或时间不足时，先缩短路线: Shorten the walk when wind or time calls for it
雾天不保证看见完整城市天际线，大风天先看航运提醒；返程受影响时及时向船员确认安排: Fog can hide the skyline; check ferry alerts when wind is strong and ask the crew about arrangements if return service is affected. A first visit need not include both the summit and the full island circuit. Turn back immediately if your current pace leaves too little time to reach the landing. Check current fire, trail and facility notices, carry your own water and do not rely on a last-minute shuttle to catch the boat.
核对出发日的去程、回程、营运商和码头，保存票务信息。: Check outbound and return sailings, operator and docks for your date, and save ticket details.

选择台阶路线或较长道路路线，设置折返和到码头提醒。: Choose the stair route or longer road route and set turnaround and dock-arrival reminders.
带水、午餐、外套和充好电的手机，查最新天气及服务公告。: Pack water, lunch, a layer and a charged phone; check current weather and service notices.
